description: Disabling Floating removes the 8px bottom gap, puts the panel against the screen edge, and reduces dock surface height to 100px.

assertions.comment: With Floating=false, removing the 8px bottom gap reduces dock surface height from 108px to 100px
The unnamed panel path (0/0/2) occupies 64px from y=36 to the end of the 100px surface and sits against the bottom
Disabling Floating does not change the visible panel height of 64px
The unnamed panel path ends at y=36; 36+64=100 exactly meets the surface bottom
